patch.summary: Render cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Render pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Hobby. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Render cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Render against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Hobby until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (infrastructure monitoring, log management, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Starter web list price is compute — Pro list price is the production workspace floor. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that want a git-push app platform with a published Pro list price production floor requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Not managed WordPress hosting (WP Engine) — landscape only

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Hobby is not production; compute still meters above the list price tile

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, git host, or a proxy network
